title: Tamsin and the Letter
author: Petra Brightwater
blurb: Cyrus Yarrow, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
